issues.description: The Bitmap24 class member 'width' has different types between template and solution repositories: the template declares 'short width' while the solution declares 'int width'. This cross-repository attribute type mismatch can confuse students (which type should be used) and may lead to subtle bugs or unexpected truncation when comparing their implementation to the provided solution or tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Bitmap24::width declaration consistent across template and solution (prefer using 'int width' in both files to match typical usage and the solution). Update the template header to match the solution's type or vice versa, and ensure any related code (constructors, allocations) uses the same type.
